[Intro]
[G]
[C]  [F#dim7]
[G#7]  [G7]
[C]  [F#dim7]
[G#7]  [G7]

[Verse 1]
[C]Stars [F#dim7]shining bright a-
[G#7]bove you [G7]
[C]Night [C/B]breezes [C/Bb]seem to
[A7]whisper I love you
[F]Birds singing in the
[Fm]sycamore tree
[C]Dream a little [G#7]dream of me
[G]

[Verse 2]
[C]Say [F#dim7]nightie night and
[G#7]kiss me [G7]
[C]Just [C/B]hold me [C/Bb]tight and
[A7]tell me you'll miss me
[F]While I'm alone and
[Fm]blue as can be
[C]Dream a little [G#7]dream [G7]of me
[C]  [E7]

[Chorus]
[A]Stars [F#m]fading but
[Bm]I linger [E]on, dear
[A]Still [F#m]craving your
[Bm]kiss [E]
[A]I'm [F#m]longing to
[Bm]linger till dawn, [E]dear
[A]Just [F#m]saying
[G#7]this [G7]

[Verse 3]
[C]Sweet dreams [F#dim7]till sunbeams
[G#7]find you [G7]
[C]Sweet dreams [C/B]that [C/Bb]leave all
[A7]worries behind you
[F]But in your dreams what-
[Fm]ever they be
[C]Dream a little [G#7]dream [G7]of
[C]me

[Piano Solo]
[C]  [F#dim7]
[G#7]  [G7]
[C]  [C/B]  [C/Bb]
[A7]
[F]
[Fm]
[C]  [G#7]  [G7]
[C]  [E7]

[Chorus]
[A]Stars [F#m]fading but
[Bm]I linger [E]on, dear
[A]Still [F#m]craving your
[Bm]kiss [E]
[A]I'm [F#m]longing to
[Bm]linger till dawn, [E]dear
[A]Just [F#m]saying
[G#7]this [G7]

[Verse 4]
[C]Sweet [F#dim7]dreams till sunbeams
[G#7]find you [G7]
[C]Sweet dreams [C/B]that [C/Bb]leave all
[A7]worries far behind you
[F]But in your dreams what-
[Fm]ever they be
[C]Dream a little [G#7]dream [G7]of me

[Outro]
[C]  [F#dim7]
[G#7]  [G7]
[C]  [F#dim7]
[G#7]  [G7]
[C]  [F#dim7]
[G#7]  [G7]
[C]  [F#dim7]
[G#7]  [G7]

[C]  [F#dim7]
[G#7]  [G7]
[C]  [F#dim7]
